assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.description: Ask about your books, review what it prepared, and choose what it does for you.
assistant.askEmptyBody: Answers use your posted figures and show where each number comes from. Nothing is changed in your books.
assistant.suggestVat: How much VAT do I owe this quarter?
assistant.suggestTopExpenses: What are my biggest expenses this year?
assistant.suggestProfit: How much profit have I made this year?
assistant.suggestOwesMost: Which customers owe me the most?
assistant.suggestUnposted: Which receipts are not posted yet?
assistant.composerPlaceholder: Ask a question about your books
assistant.answerFailed: The answer could not be prepared. Try again in a moment.
assistant.notAvailable: The assistant is not switched on for your workspace yet. Your reports have the same figures.
assistant.insufficientData: There are not enough posted entries yet to answer fully.
assistant.scanResult: {count} bank lines have a suggested category.
assistant.reviewEmptyBody: Suggestions for bank lines and flagged entries will appear here.
assistant.autoCategoriseBody: Reads new bank lines and suggests an account. You accept each one in Review.
assistant.autoCategoriseStatus: {count} bank lines looked at so far
assistant.autoChecksTitle: Check for duplicates and unusual entries
assistant.autoChecksBody: Looks for repeated payments and amounts that stand out. Findings appear in Review.
assistant.autoMatchesBody: Proposes the invoice or bill behind each bank line while you reconcile.
assistant.autoReceiptsBody: Fills in supplier, date, amount and VAT from an uploaded receipt for you to confirm.
assistant.whenUploaded: Works when you upload a receipt
assistant.automationsIntro: These run on a schedule for this company. Switch one off and it stops at its next run; anything it already made stays as it is.
assistant.automationsReadOnly: Only an owner or admin can switch automations on or off.
assistant.automationFailedHint: The last run stopped with an error. It tries again at the next run; contact support if it keeps failing.
assistant.automationSummary_classified: {count, plural, one {# line categorised} other {# lines categorised}}
assistant.automationSummary_generated: {count, plural, one {# invoice created} other {# invoices created}}
assistant.automationSummary_created: {count, plural, one {# bill created} other {# bills created}}
assistant.automationSummary_posted: {count, plural, one {# journal posted} other {# journals posted}}
assistant.automation_categorise_body: Every 30 minutes, reads new bank lines and suggests an account. You accept each one in Review.
assistant.automation_paymentReminders_bo: Hourly, sends the reminders you set up to customers with overdue invoices.
assistant.automation_recurringInvoices_b: Daily, creates the invoices your recurring templates are due for.
assistant.automation_recurringBills_body: Daily, creates supplier bills from your recurring bill templates.
assistant.automation_recurringJournals_b: Daily, posts the journal entries your recurring templates are due for.
assistant.automation_reportDeliveries_bo: Hourly, emails the report packs you scheduled.
assistant.automation_anomalyChecks_title: Check for duplicates and unusual entries
assistant.automation_anomalyChecks_body: Daily, looks for repeated payments and amounts that stand out. Findings appear in Review.
assistant.automationSummary_depreciated: {count, plural, one {# asset depreciated} other {# assets depreciated}}
assistant.automation_monthlyDepreciation: Daily, once a month has ended, posts that month's depreciation for your active fixed assets. A locked period is skipped.

assistant.fact.billOverdue: {number} · {name}, due {due}, {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} late

assistant.missing.vatIncomplete: The VAT return has items to fix before it can be filed.
assistant.missing.noOpenInvoices: No invoice is waiting for payment.
assistant.missing.noOpenBills: No bill is waiting to be paid.
